planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
Navigate to the Employees page via More menu
The Employees page loads showing a list of employees with name, role badge, phone number, and Active status
The Add Employee form opens with fields for photo, full name, phone number, job title, and access level selection (Employee or Co-Admin)
Go back and click on an employee card
The employee detail page opens showing employee info, performance stats, recent sales, and customers served
